acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Host Sean Cole tells us the story of Seattle residents who’ve had their bikes stolen, only to get them back in a way they really are not expecting.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Producer Alix Spiegel tells the story of a Lithuanian man who devises a plan to solve a problem related to the war in Ukraine.
acts.title: Cold Call to Action

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Sean Cole speaks to Washington Post reporter Siobhan O’Grady about her visit to the zoo in Kyiv.
acts.title: Zoo Unto Others

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc:
Producer Aviva DeKornfeld tells the story of Bill Edgar, who accidentally ended up helping people have a say at a moment when most people don’t get to say anything at all.
Bill Edgar has a memoir out called The Coffin Confessor.
acts.title: One Last Thing After I Go

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc: Producer Chana Joffe-Walt tells the story of a woman who took it upon herself to do something in an effort to help, and was not well received.
acts.title: A Funny Thing Happened When We Were Already AT the Theater
